summary: LDAP field-level privacy is configured and restart-persistent on both nodes. The reader can remotely search names and mail without seeing employeeNumber; anonymous users see no employee records; only the HR admin demonstration identity can read or modify employeeNumber. The original HR-4815 value and supplied LDIF remain intact.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu-compatible OpenLDAP 2.6.10 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Loaded the supplied employee record and created dedicated directory-reader and hr-admin identities.
Configured ordered LDAP ACLs for attribute-level privacy and anonymous denial.
Stored demonstration credentials in root-owned mode-600 files on node1 and node2.
Verified reader, administrator, anonymous, and denied-modification behavior from node2.
Safely rebooted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.
